summary: Phase 3 (Investment Grade / Relatório de Investimento) fully validated. 11/11 backend pytest tests pass; frontend E2E confirms both non-premium paywall (grade-paywall + unlock-grade-btn -> /planos) and premium report flow (overall-grade='B-', grade-value=€38\u00a0200, confidence-banner 'Estimativa Fundamentada · 40% dos dados formais', 5 dimension cards, 5 checklist items, 4 improvement-plan items, rationale ~523 chars). Grades are coherent with scores (to_grade thresholds verified: A+95 / A88 / A-82 / B+75 / B68 / B-62 / C+55 / C48 / C-40 / D30 / F).

issues: The 5-column `lg:grid-cols-5` inside max-w-[1200px] with a 260px sidebar is tight; on some widths the 5th card (`grade-dim-dependencia`) renders slightly clipped/muted at first frame (still visible and functional). Purely cosmetic — consider `lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3` or widening max-w to 1280 for breathing room.

critical_code_review_comments: to_grade() thresholds are monotonic and correctly used both for per-dimension and overall grade (`overall_grade == to_grade(overall_score)`). Coherence check verified in test_grade_consistent_with_score.

Endpoint gated identically to /future via `is_premium()` -> HTTPException(403, 'premium_required'). Frontend detects premium via context (`useAppData().isPremium`) — non-premium never issues the request, so paywall does not depend on a rejected round-trip.
Confidence tier calculation is straightforward and safe: 3-tier bucket based on `done/5` × 100 with margins 0.10 / 0.20 / 0.35 that widen `value_range`. `low <= company_value <= high` verified.

LLM output is graceful-degradation: try/except JSON parse; if it fails, defaults are used for `rationale`, `improvement_plan=[]`, `disclaimer`. `grade_notes` gracefully falls back to empty per-dim `why` — this means dimension cards can show empty `why` text if the LLM response fails to parse; consider a static per-dim fallback sentence.

server.py is now ~840 lines — the /investment-grade endpoint alone is ~110 lines. Continues to justify splitting server.py into modules (auth, companies, entries, ai, payments, grading). Not urgent for this ticket.

The LLM prompt template embeds the grade values (grades_txt) but leaves the LLM free to overwrite them via `overall_grade`/scores — currently the backend correctly IGNORES any grade fields the LLM might try to emit and only uses `rationale`, `grade_notes`, `improvement_plan`, `disclaimer` from the model. Good separation.
Frontend InvestmentGrade.jsx correctly gates the whole page on `isPremium` (client-side) AND the backend blocks with 403. Defense in depth is respected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (paywall + full premium report validated end-to-end against real LLM response)
